frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for English/Portuguese language switching with a translation lookup function, persisting the selected language to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning an anonymous or authenticated actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useARGameData.ts: A React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's AR game player profile from an ICP canister using Internet Identity, polling every 60 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useCookieConsent.ts: Manages cookie consent state by reading and writing a boolean flag to localStorage, exposing give and revoke consent functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useDao.ts: Provides React Query hooks for DAO proposal management (list, get, create, vote) using in-memory simulated storage instead of canister calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useICPLedger.ts: Fetches the ICP token balance for a given principal ID from the IC mainnet ledger using React Query, returning 0n for unauthenticated or anonymous principals.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using AuthClient, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useLuxuryBank.ts: Fetches and aggregates token supply, distribution, and player metrics from the backend actor to produce a LuxuryBank dashboard data structure including time series and category breakdowns.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapMarkers.ts: Fetches map markers from the backend actor using React Query with a 60-second stale time and 2-minute refetch interval.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublicChat.ts: Provides a local in-memory public chat implementation with a simulated send delay, storing messages in component state without any backend persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYLedger.ts: Fetches the QMY (ICRC) token balance for a given principal ID from the IC mainnet ledger using React Query, mirroring the ICP ledger hook pattern.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYTransactions.ts: Stub React Query hook for fetching QMY transaction history that always returns null, noting that real implementation requires icrc1_get_transactions support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYVesting.ts: Stub React Query hook for QMY vesting information that always returns null, indicating vesting data is not currently exposed on-chain.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for common backend operations including fetching/saving user profiles, updating profile info, getting map markers, and chat message CRUD.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedQMYVestin: Simulates QMY token vesting by persisting a start date in localStorage and calculating available/locked token amounts using a vesting schedule utility.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts (Cinzel, Rajdhani), sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a luxury dark/gold theme, and provides reusable component classes like glass cards and CTA buttons.
Utility functions for financial display: percentage change calculation, USD currency formatting, large number abbreviation (K/M/B), and SVG sparkline path generation.

frontend/src/lib/icp/ledgerClient.ts: Provides an ICPLedgerClient class that queries the ICP ledger canister for account balances, plus helpers to convert e8s to ICP and hex strings to byte arrays.

frontend/src/lib/icrc/ledgerClient.ts: Provides an ICRCLedgerClient class for querying QMY token balance and metadata from an ICRC-1 canister, with formatting helpers for token amounts.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/transactions.ts: Attempts to query ICRC-1 transaction history for an account via a dynamically constructed Candid IDL, returning null if the method is unsupported.

frontend/src/lib/map/simulatedMapProject: Exports a single function that converts lat/lon coordinates to 2D screen (x, y) positions using a simple equirectangular projection with zoom and center offset.
